name: PER_POSITION_BUDGETS
description: Position Budgets table that stores allocated values for headcount, FTE & amount.

columns.name: POSITION_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the position budget.

columns.name: BUDGET_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the budgetary period for which the position budget is being entered.

columns.name: BUDGET_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the budgetary period for which the position budget is being entered.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the business unit for which the position budget is being entered.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the department for which the position budget is being entered.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the location for which the position budget is being entered.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_HEADCOUNT
columns.description: Headcount allocated for the budgetary period. Sum of headcount of all applicable positions should not exceed this value.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_FTE
columns.description: FTE allocated for the budgetary period. Sum of FTE of all applicable positions should not exceed this value.

columns.name: ALLOCATED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount allocated for the budgetary period. Sum of amount of all applicable positions should not exceed this value.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
